item.title: Trail to be dedicated in honor of late Ocala radio duo killed by drunk driver
item.description: The county will consider dedicating a local nature trail in honor of Larry Whitler and Robin MacBlane, two iconic radio hosts who spent decades serving Marion County before they were tragically lost in an accident caused by a drunk driver who ran a red light.
